title: nft_sell_offers
key_points: The nft_sell_offers endpoint allows users to retrieve the offers for an NFT.
It returns a list of sell offers for the specified NFT.
The response includes offer ID, account, amount, transaction ID, and other details.
limitations: The source provides documentation rather than real-world data or examples.
It assumes familiarity with XRPL concepts and terminology.
The scope is limited to the technical implementation of the API endpoint.
asserts: The nft_sell_offers endpoint enables users to fetch sell offers for a specific NFT on the XRPL blockchain.
scope: Describes how to retrieve sell offers data for an NFT using the XRPL public API.
